description: The line plot illustrates the average repetition rate of relation categories in relation extraction tasks, comparing different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," is a categorical scale ranging from 0 to 60, representing different categories of relations. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate," is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, indicating the rate at which each relation category is repeated. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method: "w/o DPO abo & w/o div-hint" (orange line with triangle markers), "DPO" (green line with square markers), "Average of w/o DPO abo" (blue line with circle markers), "Average of w/o DPO abo & w/o div-hint" (orange dashed line), and "Average of DPO" (green dashed line). The lines show fluctuations in repetition rates across different relation categories, with some peaks and troughs indicating variability in the performance of each method.
